subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support a constrained raw `[[...]]` button JSON fallback for Gemini final text, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but the proposed parser would create a model-output fallback syntax that crosses prompt, final-reply, transcript, and Telegram presentation boundaries.

options.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget to typed routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the issue focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini emits `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Defer until live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open without accepting implementation work until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice crosses the typed presentation contract, final-reply sanitization, and Telegram button rendering paths where current-main blame is strongest in this checkout.
